title: Apples for the Neighbors

readiness.math: sharing equally: division (older: with a remainder)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: The old apple trees by the river are heavy with fruit. Our little trees will give apples like these one day!

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Let's share these out fairly: a basket for each house.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Share the apples so every house gets the same.

older.prompt: Share the apples fairly among five houses. Any that can't be shared fairly go in the left-over bowl, for pies!

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: And the left-overs go in Tobias's pies. Nothing wasted, everyone fed.

journal_line: I picked apples and shared them fairly among the houses.
unavailable_text: The apples are picked and shared.
